price_source.description: AWS Price List API, Linux On-Demand shared tenancy, us-west-1; re-query and record the response and exact query time before provisioning

billing_method.end: per-host Terraform destroy completion timestamp; running hosts accrue through check time
billing_method.rounding: ceil duration to whole seconds, with a 60-second minimum per host
billing_method.scope_note: This ledger covers EC2 instance-hours only. The aggregate AWS actual-spend alert is the account-level cap signal for storage, addresses, transfer, tax, and other billable services.

host_hour_check.rule: Run before every paid block; refuse to start unless accrued plus reserved EC2 instance cost is strictly below $75. The command blocks until all four host IDs and apply timestamps are recorded.
